messages.text:
For a refund through this process, the order must first be marked delivered. After delivery, the item must be returned and recorded as received by the shop, and the refund must be requested within 30 days of the recorded delivery time (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders; refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/window).
